list.title: Items & Services
list.description: The catalog behind every document line — services, labor, charges, and discounts.
list.emptyDescription: Add the first service, labor, or charge to start the catalog.
list.createDraftFailed: Could not create a draft item

kindDescriptions.service: Work or expertise sold without tracking physical stock.
kindDescriptions.non_inventory: A purchased or sold good whose quantity is not kept on hand.
kindDescriptions.inventory: A stocked good with on-hand quantity, valuation, and fulfillment.
kindDescriptions.assembly: A manufactured item built from a bill of materials.
kindDescriptions.kit: A sellable bundle whose component items remain distinct.
kindDescriptions.other_charge: A fee, surcharge, freight, or other standalone charge.
kindDescriptions.equipment_charge: Billable use of owned or rented equipment.
kindDescriptions.labor: Worked time with labor pricing and payroll costing behavior.
kindDescriptions.absence: Paid or unpaid time away recorded against a time entry.
kindDescriptions.discount: A reduction applied to another line or transaction total.

drawer.chooseKindDescription: Start with the accounting and operational behavior this item needs. You can confirm the type again before creating it.
drawer.nameToActivate: Name the item to activate it

pricingModes.title: Choose how this item is priced
pricingModes.description: Pricing layers can work together. Start with a base price, then add only the matrices, customer terms, or contracts this item needs.
pricingModes.simpleDescription: Set one customer price and one internal cost directly on the item.
pricingModes.simpleDetail: Best for ordinary goods and services with a stable per-unit price. These values are also the fallback when no advanced rate matches.
pricingModes.matrixDescription: Set currency, price level, and quantity-break prices in an effective-dated grid.
pricingModes.matrixDetail: Supports per-line or total-item volume calculation without requiring Projects.
pricingModes.customerDescription: Give a customer an absolute item price or assign a reusable price level.
pricingModes.customerDetail: Customer-item prices take precedence over assigned and base price levels.
pricingModes.costDescription: Build governed cost-plus or markup/discount price levels from an explicit cost basis.
pricingModes.costDetail: Generated matrix values are persisted and audited instead of silently repricing history.
pricingModes.rulesDescription: Use effective windows and customer or price-level matrices for temporary offers.
pricingModes.rulesDetail: Overlapping active rules are refused so one scope always resolves deterministically.
pricingModes.contractDescription: Price labor, equipment, and contracted unit packages by customer or project.
pricingModes.contractDetail: Use rate books for package decomposition and usage-date contract pricing.
pricingModes.subscriptionDescription: Configure recurring plans, quantities, contract versions, and amendments.
pricingModes.subscriptionRequired: Enable Subscription Billing to configure recurring pricing.
pricingModes.saveFirst: Save the item before configuring effective-dated rates.
pricingModes.featureRequired: Enable Projects to use rate books and scoped pricing.

pricingMatrix.title: Price matrix
pricingMatrix.description: Effective-dated selling prices by currency, price level or customer, with all-units quantity breaks.
pricingMatrix.breaksDescription: The greatest minimum quantity reached sets the unit price for all units.
pricingMatrix.saveFailed: Pricing schedule could not be saved.
pricingMatrix.loadFailed: Pricing schedules could not be loaded.
pricingMatrix.changeReasonHint: Required when the new prices cover dates that are already effective. The prior version is kept and the reason is recorded in the audit.
pricingMatrix.deleteFailed: Pricing schedule could not be deleted.
pricingMatrix.empty: No matrix pricing has been configured for this item.

rates.title: Advanced rate pricing
rates.description: Optional dated, scoped, or package-tier pricing. Ordinary items use the Price and Cost above without a rate book.

guide.title: How pricing works for this item
guide.simpleDescription: This item prices directly from its Price and Cost. No dates or rate-book assignment are required.
guide.advancedDescription: Matching rate books and tiers override the simple values; Price and Cost remain the final fallback.
guide.priceHelp: The amount charged per unit when no advanced bill rate matches.
guide.costHelp: The job-cost amount per unit; it is not the customer price.
guide.advancedHelp: Supports dated rate books, day/week/month packages, currencies, and scoped overrides.
guide.simpleHelp: Configure this only when the item needs more than one simple Price and Cost.
guide.simpleResolution: Item Price → customer charge. Item Cost → internal job cost.
guide.advancedResolution: Project rate book → customer rate book → equipment-unit override → organization assignment → default rate book → item Price/Cost fallback.
guide.rateTypes: Cost rate is internal cost; bill rate is customer price. Time-type rates only override labor premiums such as overtime. Fair-value prices are for revenue allocation and never choose the transaction price.

rateBookDrawer.description: Maintain the rate-book header and its complete effective-dated item rate schedule together.
rateBookDrawer.ratesHelp: Saving changed lines creates a new immutable rate version; earlier versions remain available for historical transactions.
rateBookDrawer.unchangedHelp: The item schedule is unchanged, so saving will update only the rate-book details.

costing.title: Inventory costing
costing.description: How stock for this item is valued and tracked — method, accounts, and reorder points.
costing.empty: No costing profile yet — configure one before receiving stock.
costing.unitConversionsDescription: Alternate units this item is bought and sold in, as base units per unit. Document lines in these units convert automatically; any other unit refuses posting.
costing.noConversions: None — document lines must use the base unit.
costing.conversionFactorInvalid: Enter a positive number with at most four decimal places
costing.conversionsBlocked: Fix the highlighted unit rows before saving.
costing.separationConflict: Must be different from the inventory asset account
costing.separationBlocked: Fix the highlighted accounts before saving — offset accounts must differ from the inventory asset account.

fairValue.title: Fair value prices
fairValue.description: Dated standalone selling prices (SSP) per currency, used to allocate bundle revenue across obligations.
fairValue.empty: No fair value prices yet — the single SSP above is used.

revrec.title: Revenue recognition
revrec.hint: Defer and recognize this item's revenue over time (ASC 606)
